2.120.10
ChartAxis.ChartMinorTickMarks
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The ChartAxis.ChartMinorTickMarks element specifies the minor tick marks for a ChartAxis. This
element is optional. This element is of type ChartTickMarks.
Following is the parent element of the ChartAxis.ChartMinorTickMarks element.
Parent elements
ChartAxis
The following is the XML Schema definition of the ChartAxis.ChartMinorTickMarks element.
 <xsd:element name="ChartMinorTickMarks" type="ChartTickMarksType" minOccurs="0" />
